titleAr: تأكيد انستاباي تلقائي لما الإيصال يطابق
titleEn: Instant InstaPay confirmation when the receipt matches (kill switch off by default)

en: Why is my InstaPay payment not instant?

steps: Pay the exact amount by InstaPay and upload the receipt
The receipt is read into amount, recipient, date and reference; plain code checks all of them against what is due
A full match confirms within minutes; anything else waits for a person exactly as before
If the owner finds the money did not arrive the payment goes back to unpaid with a 48 hour grace: upload a correct receipt or pay by card
edgeCases: Off by default and per workspace: the platform owner switches it (off, shadow, live) with no deploy
First automatic payment is capped at one month of the plan; a yearly first payment waits for a person
A receipt already used anywhere (any workspace, any product) never confirms again
After a not-received revert unused credits of that payment are removed, consumed ones are kept, never negative
assistantNote: Say: confirmed within minutes when the receipt matches, otherwise a person reviews it; if told not received you have 48 hours to upload a correct receipt or pay by card
